scope: Fixed L=16 hash-pinned A1 production q^-4 Gaussian on three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, embedded Pauli generators, common real-even uniformly bounded scalar Fourier multipliers converging pointwise to one with compact support or a uniform Schwartz tail, each regulator's exact derivative covariance subtraction, and exact Fourier convolution or sufficient de-aliasing.

normal_ordering.real_matrix: B(X)=sum_A[a p_A p_A^T+b(p_A v_A^T+v_A p_A^T)+c v_A v_A^T], p_A=2S_A X, v_A=2(S_A-q_A I)X
normal_ordering.complex_covariance_factor: Gamma_Lambda,i=(1/2) realify(D_Lambda,i), where D_Lambda,i=E[partial_i Psi_Lambda partial_i Psi_Lambda^dagger]
normal_ordering.finite_scheme_condition: use the exact covariance of each admitted regulator; subtraction of only delta_cube*N*W_eps is not the definition

theorem_boundary.joint_products: The covariance-normal sequences for J_A,i^2, J_A,i*K_A,i, and K_A,i^2 converge jointly; this is not an arbitrary bilinear multiplication of already-existing distributions.
theorem_boundary.convergence: For every kappa>0, e_II,Lambda^ren converges in L2(Omega; H^(-1-kappa)(T_L^3)); its spatial integral converges in L2(Omega) and has mean zero.
theorem_boundary.primitive_divergence: In the Gaussian two-point composite construction, exact conditional centering removes the only divergent local derivative-pair contraction. The exact finite Gaussian-IBP identity leaves only Q^2, QPR, and P^2R^2 cross-vertex families. No interacting perturbation-series convergence is asserted.
theorem_boundary.scheme_control: Exact covariance-normal ordering gives one common limit inside the declared common-even scalar spectral regulator class.
theorem_boundary.endpoint: H^(-1) is excluded; the dyadic shell sum is logarithmic at the endpoint.
theorem_boundary.floor: All coefficient and Gaussian-Sobolev bounds fix rho_regularizer>0; no uniform floor-removal estimate is asserted.

leading_stability_split.sharp_action_threshold: sup_(s>0) W_eps/s=h=9(a+2b+c); the leading pointwise action repair t_N*m*s is nonnegative for all fields iff m>=h
leading_stability_split.subcritical_no_go: every m<h admits a mixed-orientation homogeneous -Theta(t_N^(3/2)) trial
leading_stability_split.parameter_shift: because the family energy is (1/2) Delta_mu_N*s, the leading parameter threshold is Delta_mu_N>=2*h*delta_cube*N+O(1)
leading_stability_split.physical_boundary: the pointwise-coercive critical repair can suppress the first doublet and is not selected as a nondegenerate physical prescription

bare_negative_control.statement: Psi(x)=exp(i k.x)u has J_A=K_A=F_II=0 for every A while W_eps(u)>0 whenever the first doublet is active.
bare_negative_control.consequence: W_eps^-1(0) is not the pathwise Class-II null set, so the conditional Gaussian mean cannot by itself prove pure-third bare concentration.

frozen_background_check.statement: For deterministic B(u), the normal-ordered quadratic partition factor is det_2(I+T_u)^(-1/2), with 0<=log factor<=||T_u||_HS^2/4.
frozen_background_check.boundary: This does not condition on the full self-coupled field and does not prove a random-coefficient Gibbs estimate.
